programme.desc: Children, like adults, have days that go wrong. This film shows how one little girl overcomes the day's frustrations by diving into an underwater fantasy where she spends time with her friend, the lady octopus.

programme.title: Sylvies Story
programme.desc: The film shows Sylvie in a Montréal transition house, highlighting the hurdles of violence, loneliness, and scarcity. It emphasizes sharing experiences and transition houses' support in connecting victims with legal and social aid.

programme.title: Danish Poet, The
programme.desc: Can we trace the chain of events that leads to our own birth? Is our existence just coincidence? The Danish Poet considers these questions as we follow a poet whose creative well has run dry, on a holiday to Norway to meet a famous writer.

programme.title: Waiting For Fidel
programme.desc: Three Canadians, including ex-premier Joseph Smallwood and NFB director Michael Rubbo, travel to Cuba, aiming to cast Fidel Castro. Their journey offers insights into Cuba's changes and their own views.

programme.title: When The Day Breaks
programme.desc: In "When the Day Breaks," Ruby finds solace in unexpected places after witnessing a stranger's death. Through deft humor and detailed animation, it explores the interconnectedness of urban life, capturing the promise and fragility of each new day.

programme.title: The Town Mouse And The Country Mouse
programme.desc: Evelyn Lambart's animation style shines in this short film adapting an Aesop fable. It contrasts two mice's lifestyles, advocating for simplicity and peace over luxury amid danger.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: The qualifying rounds continue in San Antonio where competitors as young as 15 take on seasoned veterans on the world's most challenging obstacle course; the new Kickboards obstacle makes its debut on the course which ends with the Warped Wall.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: The qualifying rounds continue in San Antonio where Minions have taken over the course and brought the new obstacle Despicaballs; other new obstacles include Shattered Panes and Final Frontier in addition to the iconic Warped Wall.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: The qualifying rounds conclude in San Antonio with ninjas from across the country taking on the world's most challenging obstacle course; competitors as young as 15 take on seasoned veterans in this first round of competition from the Alamodome.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: The semifinals begin in Los Angeles where the competing ninjas face up to 10 challenging obstacles, including, for the first time, Kaleidoscope, Ghost Town and Spin Zone; the two fastest ninjas will face off on the Power Tower for a Safety Pass.

programme.title: Bloomberg Investigates
programme.desc: In Kampala, a group of midwives help vulnerable mothers give birth for free; nearby a major for-profit hospital is out of reach for most of the community, sometimes with devastating consequences.

programme.title: The Deal With Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly
programme.desc: Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly sit with Susie Wolff, the managing director of F1 Academy; they talk about how she's helping more female racers try to advance into the ranks of Formula One.

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer: The Big Business of Drilling Into the Earth
programme.desc: Geothermal has been the underdog of the energy industry, but that may be about to change as new startups use fracking technologies to expand potential geothermal sites.

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer
programme.desc: Scientists and entrepreneurs are testing radical ideas like solar radiation management and ocean fertilization; they are finding funding for them.

programme.title: Bloomberg Originals
programme.desc: Experts offer bold takes on some of today's most important topics and cover stories and investigations at the intersection of business and culture.

programme.title: The Circuit
programme.desc: Emily Chang meets GM Chief Executive Officer Mary Barra for a look at her plan to transform the veteran automaker into a fast-moving tech company.

programme.title: The Circuit
programme.desc: Emily Chang speaks with Microsoft titans Bill Gates, Steve Ballmer and Satya Nadella about the company's journey from scrappy startup to global powerhouse.
